entries.detail: 1 = might, 2 = grace, 3 = wits, 4 = nerve, 5 = signature, 6 = signature
entries.name: Opening roll
entries.notes: Final in Core Rules (character creation step 2), 2026-10-15. Simulated neutral: no rule change.
entries.text: Rolled stat +1 and another stat of the player's choice -1 (min 1); no change if the rolled stat is already 3. First Threshold = the class opening for that stat.

entries.detail: Was Depth 10, Damage 3. Retuned to keep two-Bargain lethality once running from the Crucible stopped counting as survival.
entries.name: The Crucible
entries.text: Depth 8, Difficulty 2, enemy Damage 2. It opens on Hostile and turns to a different kind after every cast; the new demand shows before the player chooses. There is no exit: Panic 7 costs your next action.

entries.name: Ally die
entries.text: +1 die while an ally is with you: a person met on a Witness Leaf who currently trusts you. One ally at a time. Attack or abandon them and they leave. Pool cap 6 still applies.

entries.detail: Scanner: Relic, Hazard. Battery: Relic. Toolbelt: Hazard, Relic. Lockpicks: Relic. Prayer cords: Witness. Ranged: rifle, pistol. Melee: torch, tool-arm, blade.
entries.name: Gear helps kinds
entries.notes: Rules thread, 2026-10-14. Per-class detail is on each class.
entries.text: An item that helps a chapter's kind adds +1 die and spends a Use. Ranged weapons fight with Grace, melee with Might.

entries.name: Director scope
entries.text: The app's director chooses only how a draw is shown (one dot, two or three shapes, or the dark) and the narrative beat (calm, foreshadow, a clue, a person acting). It never touches casts, deck order or numbers.

entries.detail: Creation roll: 1 = hush, 2 = stratum, 3 = lanes, 4 = choir, 5 = market, 6 = choice. Standing shift: At the Verdict: acted on the Tie's Aspiration +1 step; betrayed the faction -1 step. Burned dropping again = enemy, eligible as Crucible form.

example.aspiration: Make them admit what they sent us into.

entries.name: Ties
entries.notes: From the lore thread's Factions and Ties. Pending Steven's OK (ties rework, 2026-10-15).
entries.text: A Bearer holds Ties to any factions, whatever their class. Each Tie has a faction, a link (blood, service, debt, faith, trade), a standing (trusted, strained, burned) and an aspiration. One Tie from your past (class typical_tie or any faction), plus an optional second: d6 1 hush, 2 stratum, 3 lanes, 4 choir, 5 market, 6 choice.

entries.detail: trusted: helps on 4+, hurts on 1; strained: helps on 5+, hurts on 1-2; burned: helps on 6, hurts on 1-3
entries.name: Tie die
entries.notes: Retuned by the rules thread after sims, 2026-10-15 (playtest/ties_final.txt). Pending Steven's OK.
entries.text: When a chapter opens, each Bearer secretly rolls a d6: on 1-2 one of their Ties marks it (a random Tie if they hold two). Factions never mark the Crucible unless one is your enemy. A marked chapter gets one Tie die, rolled once when it opens. It sits outside the pool and can't be Pushed or refused. A help counts as +1 chapter progress (a free Hit). A hurt costs 1 Stress, or the faction hunts you: its next Hostile chapter this trial is marked by them and gets Depth +2 (one hunt at a time).
